entities.summary: Nootsara Tomkom is a Thai volleyball player who coaches and plays for the Queensis Kariya of the Japan SV League. Widely regarded as one of the best setters in international volleyball, Tomkom has been selected to play for the Thailand women's national volleyball team over 50 times.
